title: 第10章 大学教授参与洗钱？-《系统送编，从外卖员成007探员》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “喂。”顾承安按下接听。

    “顾承安，我是苏楠。”电话那头声音清冷，夹杂着隐约传来的键盘敲击声。

    “苏警官。”顾承安把电动车停在树荫下。

    “两个事。第一，奖金批下来了。”苏楠语速很快，但字字清晰，“赵辉是A级通缉犯，局里给你申请了十五万。另外那个叫孙强，查实是一个走私团伙的小头目，身上背着案子，这部分给你申请了五万。总共二十万，正在走财务流程，大概三个工作日打到你账户。”

    二十万。

    顾承安原本以为能拿到十万就不错了，毕竟不一定拿到最高悬赏。

    “谢谢苏警官。”他语气略微有些激动的感谢道。

    真心的，一般没这么快，苏警官一定是出了力的。

    “不用谢我，你应得的。”苏楠顿了顿，继续说，“第二件事，区里准备给你报一个见义勇为先进个人。另外，有两家市级媒体想采访你，做个专访。”

    “我拒绝。”顾承安毫不犹豫。

    电话那头沉默了一秒，颇为不解。

    “为什么？这对你是好事！”

    “我一个送外卖的，天天在街上跑。露了脸，以后还怎么干活？万一被赵辉或者孙强的同伙报复怎么办。”顾承安随口扯了个理由。真正原因是国安特勤的身份经不起曝光。

    “行，我明白了。”苏楠没有劝说，“见义勇为的表彰只走内部流程，不对外公开。采访我替你推掉。后续有手续需要你签字，我会再联系你。”

    “麻烦了。”

    挂断电话，顾承安长舒一口气。

    二十万。

    在这个寸土寸金的鹏城，这点钱连个厕所都买不起。但对现在的顾承安来说，这是一笔足以让他摆脱生存焦虑的巨款。

    不用再为了每天几十块钱的饭钱去拼命跑单了。

    他摘下头盔，抓了抓被汗水浸透的头发。有点长了，贴在头皮上，闷热难受。

    路边正好有一家理发店。

    顾承安推门进去。

    “帅哥，剪头发？”老板是个三十出头的精神小伙。

    “剪短，碎发，但不要剪平头，越清爽越好。”

    二十分钟后，顾承安看着镜子里的自己。

    两侧推平，头顶留了一寸多长的碎发。配上那张棱角分明的脸，整个人透着一股凌厉的精气神。

    他结了账，走出理发店。

    找了个没人的巷子，顾承安掏出菊花手机。

    点开警务通，进入国安页面，点开邮件。

    春风有消息了。

    “钱自己留着，不用上交。你的功劳已上报领导，有结果另行通知，注意安全。”

    依旧是惜字如金的风格。

    顾承安心里最后一块石头落了地。

Page (1/3)

"Hello." Gu Chengan pressed to answer.

"Gu Chengan, this is Su Nan." The voice on the other end of the phone was cold, mixed with the faint sound of keyboard tapping.

"Officer Su." Gu Chengan parked his electric car under the shade of a tree.

"Two things. First, the bonus has been approved." Su Nan spoke quickly but clearly, "Zhao Hui is a level A wanted criminal, and the bureau has applied for 150,000 yuan for you. The other one is Sun Qiang, who is found to be a small leader of a smuggling gang. He has a case on his back, and you have applied for 50,000 yuan for this part. A total of 200,000 yuan, the financial process is going through, and it will be credited to your account in about three working days."

Two hundred thousand.

Gu Chengan originally thought that it would be good to get one hundred thousand, after all, he might not get the highest reward.

"Thank you, Officer Su." He thanked him with a slightly excited tone.

“Sincerely, it’s usually not so fast. Officer Su must have done something.

"You don't need to thank me, you deserve it." Su Nan paused and continued, "The second thing is that the district is going to name you a courageous and advanced individual. In addition, two municipal media want to interview you for an exclusive interview."

"I refuse." Gu Chengan did not hesitate.

There was silence on the other end of the phone for a second, quite puzzled.

"Why? This is a good thing for you!"

"I'm a food delivery guy, running on the street every day. If my face is exposed, how can I work in the future? What if Zhao Hui or Sun Qiang's associates retaliate." Gu Chengan gave a reason casually.The real reason is that the identities of national security agents cannot withstand exposure.

"Okay, I understand." Su Nan did not persuade. "The commendation for bravery is only an internal process and will not be made public. I will decline the interview for you. If there are follow-up procedures that require your signature, I will contact you again."

"It's troublesome."

After hanging up the phone, Gu Chengan let out a long sigh of relief.

Two hundred thousand.

“In Pengcheng, where land is at a premium, we can’t even afford a toilet with this little money.But for Gu Chengan now, this is a huge amount of money that is enough to get rid of his existential anxiety.

No more struggling to pay for meals worth dozens of dollars a day.

He took off his helmet and scratched his sweat-soaked hair.It's a bit long and sticks to the scalp, making it hot and uncomfortable.

There happens to be a barber shop on the roadside.

Gu Chengan pushed the door open and went in.

“Handsome guy, do you want a haircut?” The boss is a spirited young man in his early thirties.

“Cut your hair short and break it, but don’t cut it flat. The fresher the better.”

Twenty minutes later, Gu Chengan looked at himself in the mirror.

The sides were flattened, leaving an inch or so of broken hair on top of the head.Coupled with that angular face, the whole person exuded a fierce spirit.

He paid the bill and walked out of the barber shop.

Finding an empty alley, Gu Chengan took out his chrysanthemum phone.

Click to open Police Pass, enter the National Security page, and click to open the email.

There is news in the spring breeze.

"Keep the money for yourself, no need to hand it over. Your merits have been reported to the leadership, and you will be notified of the results later. Pay attention to safety."

It is still the style of cherishing words like gold.

The last stone in Gu Chengan's heart fell to the ground.
